title: Mechanical checks for the manager
item: Three checks: protected paths (lint before merge), no push during a manager run (hook), tasks merged since the last review (limit)
motivation: A gate holds only where a script enforces it
notes: Built by manager-build/PROMPT.md. Other rules stay prose until one is broken.
done_means: Each check has passing tests for its allow and refuse cases, run in temporary git repos.

decided_for_you.chosen: a run is marked active by the file manage-run-active in the git common dir (.git/)
decided_for_you.rejected: a tracked marker file, which needs a .gitignore change outside the allowed paths; an environment variable, which a running session cannot set for its hooks
decided_for_you.would_change: two manager runs needing to run at once in separate clones

decided_for_you.chosen: the push hook fails open: no onFailure block in .claude/settings.json
decided_for_you.rejected: onFailure: block, which needs Claude Code v2.1.295 or later and blocks every Bash call in every session if the script breaks
decided_for_you.would_change: a push getting through because the hook script failed to start

decided_for_you.chosen: the hook refuses git [global options] push in any shell segment; git stash push passes; gh is not covered
decided_for_you.would_change: a manager run pushing by another route

decided_for_you.chosen: append-only lets an existing file grow at its end (old content is a prefix of the new); any other change, rename or removal fails
decided_for_you.rejected: failing every change to an existing file, which fails every iterate task because /iterate step 7 appends to EXPERIMENTS.md
decided_for_you.would_change: the owner wanting EXPERIMENTS.md strictly frozen

decided_for_you.chosen: the protected-path list and the task's may_edit are read from the working branch, not the task branch
decided_for_you.rejected: reading them from the task branch, where a task could grant itself an edit

decided_for_you.chosen: review tag review/<date>, found as the nearest review/* tag on the working branch
decided_for_you.would_change: the owner preferring one tag he moves

decided_for_you.chosen: a task merge is a first-parent merge commit whose subject starts 'Merge task <id>:'
decided_for_you.would_change: the owner merging other branches through the same subject

decided_for_you.chosen: the protected-path list and limits.json sit in .claude/skills/manage/
decided_for_you.would_change: another skill needing to read them
